ChatCard.Name: Post a chat card
ChatCard.Hint: Post a permanent chat message every time an achievement is unlocked.

ShowLocked.Name: Show locked achievements
ShowLocked.Hint: Players see achievements they have not unlocked yet, greyed out, in their trophy case. Hidden achievements always stay secret until unlocked.

ToastDuration.Name: Popup duration (seconds)
ToastDuration.Hint: How long the "Achievement unlocked!" popup stays on screen.

ToastPosition.Name: Popup position
ToastPosition.Hint: Where the popup appears on screen.

Sound.Name: Play unlock sound
Sound.Hint: Play a chime when an achievement is unlocked. Per-client setting.

SoundFile.Name: Unlock sound file
SoundFile.Hint: Audio file played on unlock. Leave the default for the built-in chime.

ShowCharacterName.Name: Show character names
ShowCharacterName.Hint: Show the character a player controls next to their name, e.g. "Bob (Thorin)".

Sparkle.Name: Sparkle effect
Sparkle.Hint: Shine sweep and badge animation on the popup.
